text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was Mejiro McQueen who emerged 
victorious in the fiercely contested Tenno 
Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin shows her frustration. 
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan turns to the fans, 
speaking words that inspire both them and 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Ines Fujin felt the gap 
between herself and Mejiro Ryan, and began 
to think about how she should face the 
cheering voices.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she become like Mejiro Ryan? To help 
her find that answer, let's build up her 
training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
